nodes.label: GlobalProgressBar Overlay Pattern
nodes.rationale: Stack+IgnorePointer pattern mirrors the web TopProgressBar in frontend/src/app/layout.tsx. Mounted at the root MaterialApp builder so every route displays the API in-flight indicator without per-form wiring.

nodes.label: Three-way AuthGate routing pattern
nodes.rationale: AuthGate implements three-way routing: needsActivation -> CompleteProfileScreen, firstLoginRequired -> ResetPasswordScreen, otherwise -> MainShell. Mirrors web /login -> /complete-profile vs /reset-password fork. MasterDataService.loadAll() is guarded by _masterDataKicked flag to prevent redundant network bursts across multiple rebuilds.

nodes.label: Bank Details First-Time vs Change-Request flow
nodes.rationale: When all three bank columns are null/empty the app writes directly via PATCH /users/me (setBankDetailsFirstTime). Once any column is set, subsequent edits create a BankChangeRequest requiring HR approval. Mirrors BankSection logic on the web /profile page.
nodes.norm_label: bank details first-time vs change-request flow

nodes.label: Master Data prefetch strategy
nodes.rationale: MasterDataService.loadAll() is triggered after AuthGate confirms a normal session (not first-login). On the activation path (CompleteProfileScreen), loadAll is triggered separately so gender/qualification dropdowns can populate. Both paths use a boolean guard to avoid duplicate fetches.

nodes.label: Sandwich Leave Acknowledgement UX
nodes.rationale: When CalculateResult.sandwichDetected is true, ApplyLeaveScreen Step 2 displays a warning banner with a mandatory checkbox. The sandwich acknowledgement must be checked before the user can proceed to Step 3.

nodes.label: Employment Ended Leave Application Guard
nodes.rationale: ApplyLeaveScreen checks employmentStatus != 'active' OR lastWorkingDay is past today. If so, renders a blocked state instead of the form. Guards against resigned/terminated employees submitting leave.

nodes.norm_label: jwt auth flow (email+password primary, google legacy)

nodes.label: Provider State Management
nodes.rationale: Provider chosen for state management in the Flutter app; mirrors ChangeNotifierProvider pattern described in CLAUDE.md for reactive UI updates

nodes.label: Firebase Cloud Messaging Integration
nodes.rationale: firebase_core + firebase_messaging together enable FCM push notifications for leave approval events on mobile

nodes.label: Secure Token Storage
nodes.rationale: flutter_secure_storage used to store JWT tokens securely on device, preventing leakage via shared preferences
